tweets: Naṭarāja, Lord of the Dance — Chola bronze, Tamil Nadu, c. 10th–11th century CE. Cast by the lost-wax method: a wax model, sheathed in clay, melted away in firing — each bronze unrepeatable, its mould destroyed the instant the image is born.
